Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the only station in Season 2 that involves Luxter Line.
  • This station is one of the last stations to come with an Official Station Souvenir.

History[]

  • April 13 2017: This station began services. Ingress Line is established.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • October 11 2021: The Ingress Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]

Ingress Flatland Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Glacier.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was the northbound terminus of Glacier Line for three years and nine months.[2]
  • This station is one of the only two stations in Glacier Line that does NOT feature a Los Sengas Coffee, with the other station being TriVillage South Station.
  • This station has confirmed the format of Glacier Line Stations. Either White Wool (For stations in the Ingress Continent) or Light Gray Wool (For stations in other areas) will be used as the main building material, coupled by a coloured wool of another color.

History[]

  • December 15 2016: This station began[3] and completed construction at the same day.[4]
  • December 16 2016: This station began services. Glacier Line is established.
  • January 2 2017: Issues with high-pitched Glacier Line announcements have been resolved.[5]
  • July 29 2017: Exits of this station have been destroyed and recovered.[6]
  • July 7 2018: Due to misuse of commands from an administrator, Glacier Station was closed for more than three hours. During that time period, services for this station are suspended.[7]
  • July 27 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]

Ingress Line is Line Number 15 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. This line has 9 stations, and was established on April 13 2017. It runs between Ingress South and Winter Point.

Description[]

Ingress Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Ingress and Winsol.

This route is represented by Light Cyan Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 15.

Currently, this route is km long, with a total of 9 stations.

History[]

  • S2E12: Ingress South - Coldland Bay
  • S2E17: Ingress South - Chilly Canyon
  • S4E6: Ingress South - Winter Point

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Northwards from Chilly Canyon Station to Winter Point Gateway. Completed
(Chapter: S4E6)

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Starting from Chilly Canyon Station, extend northeast to Winter Point Gateway to interchange with Asylum Line, Snowty Line and Rover Line. Completed
(Chapter: S4E6)
Continue extending northwards from Winter Point Gateway to Asylum to interchange with Lingshan Line and entering Coopol, where it runs alongside Coopol Line, and finally reaching Glaciss Station to interchange with Glacier Line. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Ingress
  • Winsol

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. Named after the fact that this line mainly serves Ingress.

Fun Facts[]

  • Ingress Line was originally named Snoast Line.
  • This line was originally Line Number 11.
  • This line may extend to Glacier Line Glaciss Station in the future.
  • Prior to the Construction of Shardcone Station in Season 4, Episode 6, this line did not have a station on its own, or that only serves Ingress Line. As a result, this line was the Standard Railway Line with the highest percentage of Interchanges, at 100%. The record was shortly held by both Ingress Line and Snowty Line after Season 4, Episode 5, and is now held by only Snowty Line instead.
  • This line was also one of the few lines that did not have any development throughout Season 3. [1]

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Look Around Ingress Zero Square. Find a set of stairs under the "wings".
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a block of ice.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station adopts the Spanish Solution.
  • This station is the last station to be built in Season 1. To commemorate this, the Ingress Zero Square is built near this station. The Ingress Zero Square also gets upgraded at the end of each season to highlight the progress made by Nazca Railway in that Season.
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Ingress Line.
  • This station is the first station to ever feature "Waiting Rooms" at the Platform Level. A typical "Waiting Room" features bookshelves and fireplaces for passengers to wait for their next train in warmer conditions. This would go on to become a characteristic of all ground or elevated stations at the Ingress Continent (Ingress, Glacier, Snowty, Asylum, Coopol and Winsol).
  • The Station code of this station was formerly "INS". However, upon the completion of Intus Austrum Gateway, the station code became "ISO" as Gateways have a higher priority of station coding over Area Stations.

History[]

  • January 4 2016: This station began services alongside Luxter Line, but Ingress Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • September 26 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • April 13 2017: Ingress Line is established.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]At the same day, Exit B is added to this station to connect to the Mushroom Transit Station of the same name.[6]
  • October 11 2021: The Ingress Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • October 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • August 9 2025: This station began expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • August 10 2025: This station completed expansion of the Coopol Line Part.
  • August 11 2025: Coopol Line extends from Warminal Station to this station.

  • The station name pays tribute to Neihu, Taipei City.
  • The style of the station alludes to Deepond Library in the north of the station. However there is no direct connection between these two buildings.

title: Inter-Galactic Media Group
safeHtml:
Inter-Galactic Media Group, abbreviated as IGMG, is an Public Service Broadcaster in Los Sengas.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Access
  • 3 Organizational Structure
  • 4 History
  • 5 Comments
  • 6 Citations and References

Description[]

IGMG is the first Media Organization to be established in Los Sengas, and mainly operate as an Electronic Media. It should be noted that IGMG operated independently from the Los Sengas Government at the time of its existence, and is responsible directly to Nazca.

  • Address: Media City, Flask of Solutions Industrial Area, Los Sengas
  • Name of Owner: samuel_busier (Samuel Li)
  • License Operating Area: All of Los Sengas
  • License Expiry Date: Permanent

Access[]

Currently, its headquarter is located at Los Sengas Flask Media City, and passengers can access this place using Nazca Railway Stadium Line Flask West Station or Stadium Line, Flask Line, Phoenix Line, Bravo Line Flask East Checkpoint. Alternatively, passengers may also use StarTop Railway Cadence Line Flask West Station, SLT Line 401 Media Headquarters Stop and Media City Link Media City Node for access.

Organizational Structure[]

There are two departments in IGMG:

  • Productions: Managed by Kata1026.
  • News: Managed by EarthManIsMe.

History[]

  • Formerly the Live Streaming Department of Project Nazca.
  • August 15 2015: IGMG is established and became the first Los Sengas Media Outlet.

Comments[]

  • While Los Sengas citizens believe that IGMG is trustworthy, especially after the World Gazette incident, IGMG rarely posts news.

Description[]

Interisland Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along West Metropolis Archipelago and Peckern North.

This route is represented by Dark Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 20.

This line is 24.255 km long, and has a total of 18 stations.

History[]

Important Dates[]

  • April 4 2017: This line was established after Fire Two Island Station began operations.
  • July 15 2017: This line entered a two-episode hiatus after its expansion to Deepond Island.
  • May 28 2018: This line completed construction after reaching Finnick Station.
  • April 16 2022: This line reached Arcgo West Island Station.

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is the first line in which the entirety of the route lays within West Metropolis Archipelago. However, the service area of this line was expanded to include Peckern North after the Arcgo West Island extension.
  • This line is the only Standard Railway Main Line to adopt Sub-Standard Railway platform length standards.

Fun Facts[]

  • The establishment of this line caused Edward Island Station to become a 4-line interchange and hence upgraded to a Checkpoint.
  • The planning process of this line is highly complex and had also undergone multiple changes as follows:
    • Initial plans of this line involved a total of 20 stations, but later changes has caused the final number of stations to become 17. However, there is now 18 stations due to the extension to Arcgo West Island.
    • The initial route of the South Section of this line are as follows: Edward Island, Fire Two Island, Info Island, Bell Island, Frame Island, Belt Island, Armor Island, Elevate Island, Inthree Island, Flask Island, Coubird Island and Droplet Island. While the route from Droplet Island to Finnick Island remains the same, due to routing conflicts with NFC, Nazca Railway had to reduce the number of islands that this line passes through, and plans to stop at Frame Island, Armor Island and Flask Island were scrapped in order to make NFC agree to the plans. Moreover, further consideration that Inthree Island would lose the property of "3" after having this line stopping there have changed the plans of this line stopping at Deepond Island for interchange with Arcgo Line instead.
    • Initial plans of this route involved a "Y-shaped" configuration in a fashion similar to the current New Edward Line and Kinight Line. The branch line would start at Crane Island, passing through Southeast Island, Mosaic Island and Cajotine Island, before joining the main line to Finnick Island at Earn Island. However, Nazca Railway had adjusted its development plans accordingly, and the branch line is now an independent line (Gondola Line) which acts as a northern bypass connecting this line with Stadow Line. Also, due to construction difficulties, the plan of it stopping at Cajotine Island was changed to Decajotine Island, with the plans for the main line, remains unchanged.
    • The extension to Arcgo West Island Station was not a part of the plan for this line. However, after consideration over Peckern North development, Nazca Railway extended this line to that station for interchange with Glinstrouß Line.

title: Internal Sea East Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Internal Sea East Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Flask Line and Glacier Line. It is located to the south of Internal Sea East Station. This Stabling Siding has a capacity of 20 trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

This Stabling Sidings have five sidings each, which can store 20 trains with a total of 180 carriages.

Connecting Tracks[]

Both Ends of the Stabling Sidings connect to Flask Line tracks, with Internal Sea East Station to the north and Flask East Checkpoint to the south through a tunnel under Zootuary.

Other Facts[]

This Stabling Siding is located on ground level, and high walls are set up around this stabling siding to prevent breaches into this Stabling Siding and causing potential danger.

Inthree Island, abbreviated as IIS, is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located to the east of Deepond Island and the west of Star Island, and is one of the islands that has undergone large-scaled renovation works.

Contents

  • 1 Geology
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Inthree Island Railway
    • 2.3 Maritime Transport
    • 2.4 Roads
  • 3 Facilities
    • 3.1 Public Facilities
    • 3.2 Public and Privaet Hosuing
    • 3.3 Commercial Facilities
  • 4 Citations and References

Geology[]

Inthree Island is named after the fact that it looks like a large inverted triangle. Ithas undergone change in ownership twice, with a large-scale works occurring in between. This island also has an artificial subsidiary island named Southree Isle.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • Arcgo Line Inthree Island Station

Inthree Island Railway[]

  • Vertic Line, North Loop Line Inthree Island NR Station
  • Vertic Line Stoop Island Bridge (Inthree Island South) Station
  • North Loop Line First Garden Station

Maritime Transport[]

To the southeast of this island is a car ferry designed for car use, whereas the east of this island features a passenger ferry named Inthree Island Pier.

Roads[]

This island features Route 12, which enables access to areas such as Senriyama and Glacier. The following roads also exist on this island:

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 4
  • One player is enough
  • Find a button behind one of the elevators leading to Platform 3.
  • Take the Elevator to Platform 3, and run to the east. Enter a secret door that is now opened for you.
  • Climb upstairs, and swim across the Platform 3 ceilings. Look for openings in which you can breathe.
  • Once you reach the third opening, go out to get your souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of Cocoa Beans.

Fun Facts[]

  • For all Arcgo Line Stations within West Metropolis Archipelago, a body of water behind a pane of glass is used for identification. In this station, the pane of glass is located at the ceiling.
  • While Interisland Line originally intended to serve this station, as doing so would mean that this station would lose the property of "3", Interisland Line ended up serving Deepond Island Station instead, and plans for Interisland Line travelling to this station were scrapped.

History[]

  • December 12 2015: This station began services.
  • September 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • June 8 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line INN-01 (3-3 Memorial Park Stop) and NR Buses Route 341S.

Fun Facts[]

  • Exit A of This station pays tribute to Exit A of Terracept Division Tai Nga Bay Station.
  • The Color Scheme of this Gateway is determined by the Station art at Proyga Station.
  • As the location of this station and Intus Aquilo Island as a whole deviated slightly to the north of Z=-20000, the Intus Aquilo Line is NOT seen at this station.
  • Before the expansion of the Snowty Line and Mike Line part of this station, it was already announced that this station would become a large interchange involving Urban Line, and rumors of this station becoming the first "Gateway Checkpoint" started to spread. However, as each station could only have one Station Class, and Gateways are ranked higher than Checkpoints, this station remains a Gateway and won't become Checkpoint-class.
  • While the Brown and Red stained glass panes at this station is a characteristic of Group 1 Gateways, the torches used at the Urban Line and Urban Express Platforms alludes to the design of Metropolis Terminal.
  • The original Station Number of Urban Line for this station is 3X-06, with X indicating the service of Urban Express, but due to the completion of Ribera Harbor Station, it is modified to 3X-07.
  • After the Snowty Line, Mike Line Expansion of this station, guides are provided for passengers to choose between Urban Line, Urban Express Platforms and Snowty Line, Mike Line Platforms at Exits A1, A2 and C since these exits are now connected to both the East Wing and the West Wing of the Concourse.

History[]

  • September 21 2018: This station began services alongside Urban Line, Urban Line extends from Longwington Station to this station, but Urban Express Platforms remain reserved.
  • September 22 2018: Urban Express extends from Rover Down Checkpoint to this station.
  • July 22 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[2]
  • February 13 2023: Due to the construction of Ribera Harbor Station, the Urban Line station number of this station is changed to 3X-07.
  • February 14 2023: This station began expansion of the Snowty Line and Mike Line Part.[3]
  • February 20 2023: This station completed the expansion of the Snowty Line and Mike Line part, but Snowty Line and Mike Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • February 28 2023: Snowty Line is established.
  • March 16 2023: Mike Line is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is currently the southernmost station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This Station is the last station to be built among the Group 1 Gateways.
  • The Color Scheme of this Gateway is determined by the Station art at Proyga Station.
  • As the location of this station and Intus Austrum Island as a whole deviated slightly to the north of Z=+20000, the Intus Austrum Line is NOT seen at this station.
  • A pillar of lava streams down across the center of the concourse, and a passageway leading to an observation window can be seen to the north of this station.
  • The original Station Number of Urban Line for this station is 06-3X, with X indicating the service of Urban Express, but due to the completion of Seraphynx Station, it is modified to 07-3X.
  • There was a misconception among players that this station belongs to Oasis Bay district.
  • The Platform Layout alludes to Tsing Yi Station of the MTR in Hong Kong, with Urban Line Platforms to the east and Urban Express Platforms to the west.[2]

History[]

  • October 13 2018: This Station began services.
  • July 23 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[3]

Intus Occident Gateway is a gateway on Stadium Line and Xofa Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line, Peckern Express (Intus Occident Station).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is The First Fringe.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
The First Fringe 03:08
Liminal Bearings 03:25

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is located at 20km to the west of the Center of Los Sengas ((X,Z) = (0,0))
  • This station is the first Gateway ever built in Los Sengas Division and Nazca Railway as a whole.[3]
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction terminus of Xofa Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color Scheme of this Gateway is determined by the Station art at Proyga Station.
  • While the Platform Gates of this station was originally made with ordinary glass panes, it was subsequently replaced by stained glass panes like in other Group 1 Gateways. In the case of this station, the stained glass panes are purple and pink.
  • When Xofa Line was named Xofa Crescent, the Station Number of that line was 5C-00. However, as Xofa Crescent was renamed Xofa Line due to changes in development plans, the Station Number is now 5A-00.[4]
  • Among all existing Group 1 Gateways, this station is the only Gateway that does NOT feature express lines or Veloducts of any kind. The other Group 1 Gateways are as follows:
    • Intus Orient Gateway: Features Bravo Line, a Veloduct.
    • Intus Aquilo Gateway: Features Urban Express and Mike Line, which are respectively an Express Service and a Veloduct.
    • Intus Austrum Gateway: Features Urban Express, an Express Service. This makes Intus Occident Gateway the only Group 1 Gateway that does not feature any Express Services and Veloducts.

History[]

  • June 14 2016: This station began services alongside Stadium Line, but Xofa Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 18 2017: Xofa Line (Then Xofa Crescent) is established.
  • May 13 2021: Due to changes in development plans, Xofa Crescent is renamed Xofa Line, and the Station Number of Xofa Line has changed.[5]
  • January 10 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[6]
  • September 15 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[7]

title: Intus Occident Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Intus Occident Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Stadium Line. It is located between Woyi Gap Station and Intus Occident Gateway. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Katadelphia Depot and Spade Valley Stabling Sidings, as well as support train flow needed for the Western Extension of Stadium Line. This Stabling Siding is estimated to have a capacity of up to ten 9-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have five sidings each, which can store ten trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to Stadium Line, with access to Woyi Gap Station to the west and Intus Occident Gateway to the east.

Other Facts[]

Besides of increasing the capacity for Stadium Line, this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing Stadium Line dispatch frequencies in mind. This Stabling Siding is located under a mountain, and is hence underground. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Katadelphia Depot.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color Scheme of this Gateway is determined by the Station art at Proyga Station.
  • This station is the 200th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is the last existing station to be built in 2017.[2]
  • While the Platform Screen Doors of this station was originally made with ordinary glass panes,[3] it was subsequently replaced by stained glass panes like in other Group 1 Gateways. In the case of this station, the stained glass panes are yellow and orange.
  • This page is the 2450th page of this wiki.

History[]

  • November 29 2017: This Station began services.
  • November 23 2020: Exit C2 is added to this Station.[4]
  • March 5 2023: This station completed exit naming.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station has the shortest English Name in Los Sengas Division and Nazca Railway as a whole with just two letters. However, as the station code requires three letters, the first letter is repeated from this station to obtain IOI.
  • The name of this station also alludes to Io, one of the moons of Jupiter.
  • While the design of this station alludes to Europa Checkpoint, the higher floor height of 13m in this station gives this station a sense of spaciousness.[2]

History[]

  • February 8 2020: This Station began services.
  • July 31 2025: Exits D and E are added to this Station.[3]

Islands Line was the fourth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Ocu Hill and Taiiin Hill, and had a total of 31 stations. It was established alongside Terracept Terminal on December 8 2012. Moreover, a branch between Athena Harbour and Mono Bracket, serving Dawn South, Twilight North and Cen Rarity, was set up on this branch, which commenced services on July 21 2014. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Islands Line was the fourth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from southwest Terracept in Tremend Sea to southeast Terracept Continent, before turning back northwest and briefly enters Vertin Peninsula.

This line was represented by red Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 4.

At the time of its closure, this route was 40.565 km long, with a total of 31 stations.

  • December 8 2012: Terracept - Mark 4

  • February 21 2013: Grass Island - Green Island

Islands Express was the Express Line of Islands Line. This line used the letter "X" to represent "Express". Islands Express was established on January to February 2015 as the long-distance express service of Islands Line.

At the time of its closure, Islands Express had a total of 3 stations, and only ran between Terracept and Mono Bracket, but it had a planned service length of 37.5 km.

Line Characteristics and Fun Facts[]

Main Line (Islands Line)[]

  • This line is the longest District Railway line in Terracept Division, and also has the most stations.
  • While this line mainly runs in the south-north orientation, after passing through Terracept Terminal, it also detoured to southeast Terracept Continent before returning to the southwest at Tremend Sea.
  • While this line only had two termini, a spur line featuring three stations between Athena Harbour and Mono Bracket was featured. This layout alludes to Northern Line of the London Underground, and this line is the only line before East Ring Line of Los Sengas Division to feature such a layout.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend three more stations from Taiiin Hill station, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

Express Line (Islands Express)[]

  • When Express Lines are also considered, this line is the last line to be established in the Terracept Division.
  • According to the Project Nazca Wiki, the express service had plans to extend to Tremend Box, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.

Overall[]

  • This line is the only line in Nazca Railway history to feature both a spur line and an express service.
